mode: real local backend (VITE_MARKET_MODE=api, VITE_AUTH_MODE=api; PostgreSQL + PostGIS)

results.name: A1 the app loads its market from the backend before rendering: GET /markets and GET /markets/current/coverage, no token
results.detail: GET /markets, GET /markets/current/coverage, GET /markets, GET /markets/current/coverage, GET /restaurants, GET /cuisines

results.name: A2 snapshot = backend data: India (INR, en-IN, Asia/Kolkata, metric, +91), public ids are UUIDs, 22 public cities, 15 service areas as PostGIS polygons, 3 live corridors
A3 nothing that customers must not see is in the snapshot: no draft market, no Kolkata (disabled state), no TESTING / PLANNED corridor, no launch stage or priority
A4 home renders in the market the backend serves: document language en-IN (device locale is en-US), no foreign currency, no country selector
A5 Noida (inside an ACTIVE service area): the page asks POST /availability/location and lists restaurants
A6 Lucknow (India, outside every service area): backend says OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA → "not available in this area yet", zero restaurants
A11Y axe (customer unavailable state) no serious / critical violations
A7 San Francisco: backend says MARKET_UNSUPPORTED and names no market (the US draft stays invisible) → "isn't available in this location yet"
A8 Vapi (paused city): backend says CITY_UNAVAILABLE; the customer gets the unavailable state, not restaurants from elsewhere
A9 public API never exposes a draft market: /markets lists India only, /markets/current?country=US is 404 market_unavailable
B1 market overview is built from the admin API (GET /admin/markets, /map, /configuration with the admin token)
B2 India is the one active market; the backend's draft markets (US, UK, UAE) are listed as future / Draft only
B3 coverage map draws the PostGIS service-area polygons (15 paths) and says where the data comes from
A11Y axe (admin market overview) no serious / critical violations
B4 States & UTs: all 36 Indian states / union territories from the backend; 27 are only Planned (reference geography, not an operating claim)
B5 a status jump the backend does not allow (DISABLED → ACTIVE) is refused with 409 and the reason is shown; nothing changes
B6 Cities: 23 cities from the backend with state, status and launch stage
B7 pausing a city is a high-impact change: the dialog demands a reason before anything is sent
B8 city paused through the admin API (200); the backend immediately stops serving Jaipur (CITY_UNAVAILABLE) and the public coverage shows it PAUSED
B9 audit event written by the backend: city.updated, actor = the signed-in admin, the reason, ACTIVE → PAUSED, request id
B10 the table shows the new status after the reload from the backend
B11 reactivated (200): Jaipur is serviceable again
B12 Service areas: 15 areas, boundary = polygon (PostGIS), status choices are the backend's (Testing, not Pilot)
B13 a service area moved to TESTING is internal: a point only it covers is no longer serviceable (SERVICE_AREA_PAUSED)
B14 back to ACTIVE: serviceable again
B15 Route corridors: 7 corridors from the backend (Active / Testing / Planned / Paused) with highway and via cities
B16 Configuration from the backend: INR / en-IN / Asia/Kolkata, PIN code label
B17 Features: the market's 10 feature flags; cash at pickup and cross-border are locked by the backend
B18 feature enabled through the admin API: the public market payload changes at once (cache invalidated)
B19 feature switched back
B20 a locked feature cannot be enabled even by calling the API directly (409 feature_locked) — cash at pickup stays NOT APPROVED
A11Y axe (admin market features) no serious / critical violations
B21 optimistic concurrency: a write with an old version is refused (409 stale_update) and changes nothing
B22 a self-intersecting polygon is rejected by PostGIS validation (422 invalid_geometry) and not stored
B23 India paused through the admin API: the backend answers MARKET_PAUSED and no public market is listed
B24 with the market paused the customer web (fresh load) offers nothing: unavailable state, zero restaurants
B25 India resumed: Delhi is serviceable again and the market is public again
B26 every change of this run is in the backend audit trail (city, service area, features, market)
